decisions.reason: Presenting the hero photo on a recognizable mobile phone does not change the established hero headline or explanatory copy.
The source changes the composition of the hero product visual but does not modify the landing page's clean, minimal SaaS design style or approved design reference.
Displaying the hero photo on a recognizable mobile phone does not require animation or alter the animation-free presentation constraint.
The requested framing of an existing hero photo does not change the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.
The source explicitly concerns the top hero photo and does not change the separate replacement image in the bottom-page section.
